correctness.rationale: PASS: RESULT.md defines positive fixed offsets independent of n and a lexicographic two-stage optimum for t_m(n)=s_2(n) mod m, all integers m>=2. At n=0, the unique admissible d<=2^m-1 is B=2^m-1, so the least horizon is B. Binary-carry case separation proves the explicit 2m-1 offsets all work for every n: if no low power-of-two works, the low bits have 0^a1^(m-a) with upper trailing-one run T; choosing the complementary offset 2^m-2^(a-r), r=T mod m in {1,...,a}, changes popcount by a-(a-r)-T= r-T divisible by m. The proof provides exact disjoint admissible shift sets E(0)={B}, E(N_j)={2^j} for j<m, and m-2 upper-half weight classes, forcing 2m-1 distinct offsets. Checked the carry/weight algebra, boundaries m=2, low-zeros case, and that necessary class membership is not claimed sufficient. Independently enumerated E(n) and all offsets for m=2..8, tested n<3000; this finite check corroborates, but does not establish the infinite claims.
